security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, when CSR misa.A is cleared (A extension disabled at runtime) but the decode stage does not reject Zaamo/Zabha opcodes before execution, the AMO instruction proceeds to the execute stage. If the RTL's TRAP_ON_UNIMPLEMENTED_INSTRUCTION parameter is false (or the reserved_instruction implementation defaults to unpredictable), the hardware enters undefined microarchitectural state instead of raising IllegalInstruction—potentially allowing the AMO to complete with arbitrary results. Additionally, Zabha (byte/halfword AMO) instructions may lack any misa.A gating entirely per the review comment that Zabha checks were removed from the final code.
security_spec.summary: Spec change replaces unconditional IllegalInstruction trap on AMO-with-misa.A=0 with a configurable reserved_instruction() that may enter unpredictable state instead of trapping, creating a privilege escape where clearing misa.A fails to disable atomic memory operations in hardware
